whats_new.title: Experience levels, and an icon and a dark theme that follow your colour
notes: Settings, Training has three experience levels. Beginner stays the default. Intermediate and Advanced add sets, tighten the rep ranges, lengthen the rests and the warm-up ramp, and deload harder. The plan rebuilds from today when you change it.
The app icon follows the look: the colour you pick, light or dark. The Android app switches its launcher icon at once; the web app refreshes its icon the next time Chrome checks.

After this update the home screen icon may need adding back once on some launchers, because the icon moved to a new component. Settings, Look has a switch to keep the icon green if your launcher misbehaves.
The dark theme no longer leans green when you pick another colour: the page, cards and text take a whisper of your colour in both themes, and on Android the status bar does too.
